<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תשרי_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518914707_theRebbe_174" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_A9_D7_A8_D7_99_meluket__BH_POST_1766518914707_theRebbe_174__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that "near" and "far" refer to tzaddikim and baalei teshuvah, and that through teshuvah, specifically from a state of distance, one draws from a higher level, the level of "far" that is above the chain of descent, which is a concealment that is not in existence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And the point of the explanation in this is,</t>
    <t s="2">that "near" and "far" refer to tzaddikim and baalei teshuvah.</t>
    <t s="3">And as it is written,</t>
    <t s="4">"Peace, peace, to the far and to the near,"</t>
    <t s="5">and it is known</t>
    <t s="6">that "peace to the near" refers to tzaddikim,</t>
    <t s="7">and "peace to the far" refers to baalei teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="8">to the far who has become near.</t>
    <t s="9">And through teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="10">a closeness after the distance,</t>
    <t s="11">behold, specifically through this they draw from a higher aspect,</t>
    <t s="12">the aspect of "far"</t>
    <t s="13">(which is above the chain of descent),</t>
    <t s="14">the aspect of concealment that is not in existence.</t>
    <t s="15">Therefore, in the place where baalei teshuvah stand, even completely righteous tzaddikim cannot stand.</t>
    <t s="16">For although even in tzaddikim there is the service of teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="17">since teshuvah is a mitzvah</t>
    <t s="18">(for every single person),</t>
    <t s="19">it can be said,</t>
    <t s="20">that the advantage of teshuvah is that teshuvah is in a manner of leap,</t>
    <t s="21">and this matter is in simple teshuvah.</t>
    <t s="22">For when the performance of teshuvah is because it is a mitzvah to do teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="23">his teshuvah is in order and gradation,</t>
    <t s="24">and the matter of the leap in teshuvah is primarily in simple teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="25">in those who were initially in a far place.</t>
    <t s="26">And although even by tzaddikim there is a feeling of distance,</t>
    <t s="27">for even by them there is contemplation</t>
    <t s="28">(of the exaltedness of G-d, blessed be He, and)</t>
    <t s="29">of the lowliness of man,</t>
    <t s="30">it is understood,</t>
    <t s="31">that the feeling of distance from this contemplation is not comparable to the feeling of distance of evil</t>
    <t s="32">and "the bitterness of your forsaking the L-rd your G-d."</t>
    <t s="33">And since the baalei teshuvah were</t>
    <t s="34">(initially)</t>
    <t s="35">in a most distant place,</t>
    <t s="36">in the lowest of low places,</t>
    <t s="37">therefore their service is with greater force, with a storm,</t>
    <t s="38">with superior strength,</t>
    <t s="39">and through this they reach the most exalted place.</t>
    <t s="40">And particularly according to the known teaching of the AriZal,</t>
    <t s="41">that the reason a person needs to go to the desert [to elevate sparks] is because the sparks in the desert are more exalted than the sparks in the settled land,</t>
    <t s="42">for whatever is highest, when it descends, it descends to the lowest of low places.</t>
    <t s="43">From this it is understood a fortiori regarding the matters</t>
    <t s="44">(transgressions)</t>
    <t s="45">upon which the matter of simple teshuvah applies,</t>
    <t s="46">that the sparks within them are most high,</t>
    <t s="47">therefore they descended to the lowest of low places.</t>
    <t s="48">For this is also one of the reasons that simple teshuvah is with the inner and hidden powers of the soul,</t>
    <t s="49">even to the inner voice that is not heard,</t>
    <t s="50">because in order to refine and elevate these sparks that are most high and fell to the lowest,</t>
    <t s="51">it is specifically through the inner and hidden powers,</t>
    <t s="52">the aspect of concealment that is not in existence.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section presents a parable of a king with many daughters, some married near and some far, representing souls in bodies; the near ones are tzaddikim whose service is orderly, while the far ones are baalei teshuvah whose service requires special effort and is by way of a leap.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is a parable: to what can this be compared? To a king who had many daughters,</t>
    <t s="2">some married in a near place and some married in a far place.</t>
    <t s="3">"Daughters" are the souls clothed in the body.</t>
    <t s="4">And the daughters are married,</t>
    <t s="5">for the matter of the descent of souls below to be clothed in a body is in order to make for Him, blessed be He, a dwelling place in the lower worlds,</t>
    <t s="6">through the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="7">beginning with the first mitzvah, "Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it,"</t>
    <t s="8">the matter of "be fruitful and multiply" in spirituality</t>
    <t s="9">(addition of light, etc., through the service of Torah and mitzvos in general),</t>
    <t s="10">and also the matter of "be fruitful and multiply" in its simple sense,</t>
    <t s="11">"He created it to be inhabited,"</t>
    <t s="12">through which the world becomes a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="13">And this is the matter of "daughters married,"</t>
    <t s="14">for the matter of marriage is for the sake of procreation</t>
    <t s="15">in spirituality and in physicality,</t>
    <t s="16">so that there will be a drawing down and revelation of the power of the Ein Sof below.</t>
    <t s="17">However, within this itself, there are those married in a near place,</t>
    <t s="18">and this is the matter of the service of tzaddikim who engage in Torah and mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="19">and there are those married in a far place,</t>
    <t s="20">and this is the matter of the service of refinement in matters of the permitted, and particularly the service of teshuvah.</t>
    <t s="21">And this is what [the parable] says, that those married in a near place have the ability to come and go, unlike those married in a far place who do not have the ability to come and go,</t>
    <t s="22">for tzaddikim,</t>
    <t s="23">since they did not descend so low and are in a near place,</t>
    <t s="24">therefore no special effort and special alacrity is needed for this,</t>
    <t s="25">and this can take time</t>
    <t s="26">("they have the ability in their time"),</t>
    <t s="27">meaning that their service is in order and gradation.</t>
    <t s="28">In contrast, baalei teshuvah,</t>
    <t s="29">since they descended to the lowest and were in a far place,</t>
    <t s="30">and even after teshuvah there is a concern that they might return to their [evil] ways, G-d forbid,</t>
    <t s="31">therefore this requires effort and alacrity, and it is impossible to wait</t>
    <t s="32">("they do not have the ability in their time"),</t>
    <t s="33">meaning that their service is specifically in a manner of leap, above order and gradation,</t>
    <t s="34">and also regarding time in its simple sense, the service of teshuvah is in one hour and in one moment,</t>
    <t s="35">one acquires his world in one hour.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that while baalei teshuvah need special effort due to their deficiency, this very distance awakens in them the distant and hidden powers of the soul, leading them to a level of concealment that is not in existence, unlike tzaddikim whose service is with near powers and reaches a level of concealment that exists.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And although that baalei teshuvah need special effort and alacrity is due to their deficiency,</t>
    <t s="1">because they were in a far place</t>
    <t s="2">(and it is impossible to wait,</t>
    <t s="3">"they do not have the ability in their time"),</t>
    <t s="4">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="5">this very thing</t>
    <t s="6">(that they were in a far place)</t>
    <t s="7">awakens in them also the matter of distance for the better.</t>
    <t s="8">For tzaddikim who were in a near place,</t>
    <t s="9">their service is with the near powers of the soul</t>
    <t s="10">(the revealed powers),</t>
    <t s="11">and also the service itself,</t>
    <t s="12">their ascent each and every day</t>
    <t s="13">(for each and every day one must ascend in holiness),</t>
    <t s="14">is in closeness,</t>
    <t s="15">in order and gradation</t>
    <t s="16">(meaning that each level is in relation and closeness to the level they were in initially),</t>
    <t s="17">and also the place</t>
    <t s="18">(the aspect above)</t>
    <t s="19">that they reach through their service is an aspect of a near place,</t>
    <t s="20">a concealment that exists.</t>
    <t s="21">In contrast, baalei teshuvah who were in a far place,</t>
    <t s="22">their service is with the distant and hidden powers of the soul, even to the essential powers,</t>
    <t s="23">for this, that they were initially in a far place,</t>
    <t s="24">this distance awakens the distant powers of the soul,</t>
    <t s="25">and also the service itself</t>
    <t s="26">(their ascent)</t>
    <t s="27">is in an aspect of distance and leap, not in order and gradation</t>
    <t s="28">(meaning that the level they ascend to is in distance and not at all comparable to the levels they were in initially),</t>
    <t s="29">and also the place</t>
    <t s="30">(the aspect above)</t>
    <t s="31">that they reach is an aspect of a far place,</t>
    <t s="32">a concealment that is not in existence.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
